value.text: {"sql": "SELECT hr_utc, usgs_oliver_tailwater_ft, nws_oliver_tailwater_ft, ABS(usgs_oliver_tailwater_ft - nws_oliver_tailwater_ft) AS stage_diff_ft, nws_oliver_cfs, usgs_northport_cfs FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc BETWEEN '2026-10-18 06:00' AND '2026-10-25 06:00' AND usgs_oliver_tailwater_ft IS NOT NULL AND nws_oliver_tailwater_ft IS NOT NULL ORDER BY hr_utc LIMIT 200", "purpose": "Verify USGS and NWS Oliver tailwater stage identity and flow divergence"}
